data.name: Ehtisham
data.gender_notes: Ehtisham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ehtisham is derived from the Arabic word 'h-t-sh-m' which means 'to respect', 'to honor', 'to show dignity'. The term is used to describe a person who is held in high esteem due to his or her noble character and conduct. The name Ehtisham carries the meaning “Respect, Honor, Dignity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ehtisham usually hope their child will grow to embody respect, honor, dignity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects respect and honor towards Allah and His creation.
data.etymology: Ehtisham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Respect, Honor, Dignity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ehtisham total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إحتشام
in_arabic.long_meaning: إحتشام هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ح ش م' والذي يعني الإجلال والإكرام والتعظيم. يعتبر اسم إحتشام من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني رفيعة و noble، وهو شائع الاستخدام في الثقافة الإسلامية لما له من دلالة على الاحترام والكرامة. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الفعل 'حشم' في سياق الإجلال لله تعالى، مما يعزز القيمة الروحية للاسم.

in_urdu.name: احتسام
in_urdu.meaning: احتسام کا مطلب ہے احترام، عزت، اور تعظیم
in_urdu.long_meaning: احتسام ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے احترام، عزت، اور تعظیم. یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ عزت، احترام، اور کرامت کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے. اسلامی تقليد میں، احتسام کو ایک ایسے شخص کی صفت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی عزت و احترام کرنے والا ہے.

in_hindi.name: इहतिशाम
in_hindi.meaning: इहतिशाम का अर्थ है सम्मान, आदर और महत्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: इहतिशाम एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सम्मान, आदर और महत्व. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में व्यापक रूप से प्रयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह सम्मान, आदर और गरिमा का प्रतीक है. इस्लामी परंपरा में, इहतिशाम को एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के गुण के रूप में देखा जाता है जो अल्लाह की इज्जत करने वाला है.

in_pashto.name: احتشام
in_pashto.meaning: احتشام د احترام، عزت او تعظیم معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: احتشام د عربي ريښې نوم دی چې د احترام، عزت او تعظیم معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو په منځ کې مشهور دی ځکه چې دا د عزت، احترام او کرامت استازیتوب کوي. په اسلامي دود کې، احتشام د هغه چا ځانګړتیا ګڼل کیږي چې د الله تعالیٰ د عزت او احترام کوونکی دی.

in_english.name: Ehtisham
in_english.meaning: Ehtisham means respect, honor, and dignity
in_english.long_meaning: Ehtisham is derived from the Arabic root 'h-sh-m' which signifies respect, honor, and dignity. This name holds a revered position in Islamic culture due to its connotations of esteem and veneration. The Quran references actions related to 'h-sh-m' in contexts of reverence for Allah, thereby imbuing Ehtisham with spiritual significance. Historically, the name Ehtisham has been used across Muslim societies to denote individuals of noble character, embodying values of respect and honor.

Thus, the name Ehtisham is a source of pride for the family and community, and a reminder of the importance of respect and dignity.

He was respected and loved by all, and his life was a model for his followers to emulate. The name Ehtisham is a reminder of the importance of striving for excellence in character and conduct, and seeking the pleasure of Allah (God) through acts of virtue and good deeds. Ultimately, the name Ehtisham is a source of motivation and inspiration, reminding us of the great reward that awaits those who overcome their ego and selfish desires to become people of respect and honor in both this world and the next.

historical_references.context: Ehtisham was a title given to the governor of Egypt during the Umayyad Caliphate. He is known for his unjust rule, which led to widespread rebellion and ultimately his removal from power.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Maqrizi's Kitab Al-Khitat Al-Masriyah The name Ehtisham carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ehtisham was also a Mamluk amir (slave soldier) who rose to prominence under Sultan Qaitbey. He is remembered for his military conquests and successful defense of Egypt against the Ottoman Turks.
